mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed high-potency GABA-A BZD-site positive allosteric modulator; loprazolam structural analog. Distinct from flualprazolam.
mechanismOfAction.description: Designer imidazobenzodiazepine; fluorinated analog of loprazolam (NOT flualprazolam — distinct compound). Described as very high potency in NPS literature; no published Ki/EC50. No validated human dosing data. Loprazolam's half-life cannot be reliably extrapolated to this compound.
